verdict.rationale: Recruitee's own docs show a database of potential candidates and talent pools that can be created as offers, plus emailing candidates and templates. That covers the prospect-pool part of a talent CRM. Nothing in the evidence documents automated, personalized email sequences, open/click tracking, or nurture campaigns for future roles. missing for 10: personalized email sequences, email tracking, nurture campaigns, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a recruiter, sourcing lives in a talent CRM — pools of prospects, personalized email sequences with tracking, and nurture campaigns for future roles

citations.quote: Build up your own database of potential candidates
Create a company offer (job or talent pool).
Email candidates, team members, and recruiters – all in one place
Streamline your processes by creating templates
